title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 9 and 15, dark-theme curves crossing amber peak bands; insulin.jsx Curve()
findings.title: Peak overlays reduce curve contrast below the required 4.5:1
findings.problem: The accent-colored curves have only approximately 3.0–3.2:1 contrast against the composited amber bands in dark mode. The teal glow further reduces contrast locally. The source comment claiming at least 4.5:1 over these fills is incorrect.
findings.fix: Reduce the dark-theme amber-band opacity or add a card-colored separating stroke beneath each curve. Test contrast against the fully composited band, area fill and glow—not against the card background alone.

assessment: Minor revision needed: the dark-theme peak overlays fail the project's contrast requirement.
